g.text: EXTRA NEEDS
+340 kcal (2nd tri),
lactation; protein
+25 g; fluids UP
"eat better,
not twice"
IRON+FOLATE
daily tabs ANC;
with C, away tea;
dark stools normal;
folate preconception
anaemia = PPH risk!
CALCIUM+I+D
milk/small fish +
sun; IODISED salt;
low calcium linked
pre-eclampsia risk
supplement gaps
GAIN (term): normal BMI 11.5–16 kg; underweight 12.5–18; overweight 7–11.5; obese 5–9.
Track ANC monthly — flat/falling = feed + hunt (anaemia? malaria? worms? twins? BP?).
AVOID: alcohol (NO safe amount — FAS!) · smoking · raw/undercooked meat-fish-eggs ·
unpasteurised milk · high-mercury big fish · excess vitamin A pills (liver+supps caution) ·
"herbs to widen birth canal" (unproven + risky — counsel kindly, involve elders).
NAUSEA/PICA/HB: small frequent dry-ish meals + ginger + B6 foods; PICA (clay/ice) =
iron hunt + counsel (clay blocks iron + parasites!); Hb each trimester + treat trio (iron +
malaria + worms — M01); constipation (fluids + fibre + move); heartburn (small + upright).
GESTATIONAL DIABETES (flag + refer): risk (obese, prior big baby/GDM, family) → screen per
protocol → diet (M04 diabetic plate + walks) + glucose watched → big baby/shoulder dystocia
prevented. Pre-eclampsia: BP + urine + calcium + refer fast — diet helps, delivery cures.
LACTATION: +500 kcal + protein + fluids (drink to thirst + pale urine) + CONTINUE iron/folate
3 mo + iodised salt + calcium/D; NO alcohol/smart drugs pass freely — counsel abstinence;
eat RAINBOW (milk quality follows diet); rest + support = supply (stress + exhaustion dry
more breasts than diet does — involve family!).
MYTHS (negotiate, never mock): "egg = big baby/thief" (eggs = brain food!) · "eat down to
ease labour" (starved mothers bleed + tear) · "pepper spoils milk" (eat normally, watch baby)
· "colostrum dirty" (LIQUID GOLD — M06/next lesson!). Grandmothers counselled WITH mothers.
Exam line: \"better not twice, iron with C, zero alcohol — grandmothers counselled too.\"
